messages:
Maya P.: Kicking off planning for the co-hosted summit session with NorthStar on May 18. Need to lock speakers, demo plan, booth staffing, and swag + marketplace shout. Link to partner brief: https://redwood.co/partners/northstar-summit-brief :spiral_calendar: 
Devin L.: Thanks — marketing here. Slide deck deadline? Also need bio/headshots for NorthStar speaker and our engineer by EOD Friday. PR cadence: embargo lift 48h before session.
Jordan C.: For the demo: we want a live inference demo (very short) + a fallback recording. Hardware partner EdgeHub said they can bring a T4 rack if we need edge HW. Can we confirm model + dataset?
Maya P.: Good call. Proposal: 90s intro (joint), 6-min live demo (generate + rerank path), 3-min Q&A, then 2 station deep-dive at booth. Does that fit the 15-min slot?
Devin L.: 15 total — that fits. I'll build a 3-slide hero + 1 slide each for NorthStar and Redwood. Drop decks to #design by Thurs. Also need logo assets (svg) and speaker pronouns.
Khaled (EdgeHub): We can bring the mini rack and a GPU laptop for backup. AV note: we need 1x HDMI + local network (no internet required for demo) and a power strip. Happy to coordinate pickup.
Sasha R.: Shipping window for swag to venue: send by May 10 to vendor warehouse. Please confirm quantities. Customs forms needed for demo hardware — provide HS codes.
Priya K.: Running NDA check — NorthStar requested a short demo that touches on integrated SI connectors. Need to confirm no customer data in demo and get a signed MSA addendum before preprod access.
Jordan C.: Demo script draft (super short):
```
- Start: intro + problem statement (30s)
- Live: query -> generation -> rerank -> embed-based similarity (6m)
- Failure case: show fallback to quantized model (1m)
- CTA + slide to booth (30s)
```
Maya P.: Love it. Jordan, can you film the fallback recording and drop video in GDrive? We need a >30s clip for the stream backup.
Devin L.: Swag plan: 500 stickers, 200 tees (unisex), 150 laptop sleeves (branded). Budget approved but need final sizes and numbers by Mon. Also request for a small giveaway tied to cloud marketplace signups (promo code).
Sasha R.: Confirmed warehouse address: 145 Logistics Way, Suite B. Carrier prefers pallet labels by May 9. HS codes for electronics: 8471; for apparel: 6109.
Khaled (EdgeHub): We'll supply a contact (Murat) for hardware pickup and will include a short checklist. Also need a network config file for offline demo — will share.
Priya K.: Legal checklist: signed addendum, no customer data, recorded consent for streaming the demo (if attendees are shown). I'll draft addendum and ping NorthStar legal.
Devin L.: Can EventBot create a rehearsal invite? Need a dry run w/ AV team + NorthStar on May 15 (30m). Also add SLACK channel #summit-northstar.
EventBot: Created calendar event "NorthStar Summit Dry Run" for 2026-05-15 10:00-10:30 PT. Invites sent to Maya P., Devin L., Jordan C., Khaled (EdgeHub), NorthStar-rep.
Maya P.: Great — last items: who staffs the booth during session? Proposed schedule: 12:30–1:00 Jordan + Khaled (demo), 1:00–1:30 Devin + Maya (leads), 1:30–2:00 rotating. Add volunteers here. :raised_hands:
Jordan C.: I'll cover the demo station and the live-check 30m before show.
Khaled (EdgeHub): Murat will be on-site for the hardware handoff and can stay for first 45m.
Devin L.: I'll coordinate the marketplace promo code and lead capture form (we use Square + Qualtrics flow). Can we add a QR on the handout?
Sasha R.: Logistics TODOs: 1) finalize quantities by Mon 2) ship swag + hw by May 10 3) upload labels + customs docs 4) confirm on-site contact. I'll tag ops once confirmed.
Maya P.: Perfect. Action items recap: speakers + bios (Devin) by Fri; slide deck (all) by Thurs; demo video (Jordan) by May 12; swag counts (Devin) by Mon; NDA/addendum (Priya) ASAP; hardware manifest + network file (Khaled) by May 7; dry run scheduled (EventBot). I'll follow up with NorthStar to confirm their speaker and add them to the channel. :thumbsup:
